definitions.explanation: Being of the same kind or character as something else, with no real difference between the members of a group. Often used critically of groups, products, or ideas that have all become alike.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{同質|どうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: The two are the same kind of problem.

examples.japanese: {同質|どうしつ}な⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{発想|はっそう}→発想：04309_hassou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれ→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧にくい。
examples.english: When all the members are alike, new ideas are hard to come by.

examples.japanese: ⟦どの→どの：00551_dono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧ような⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{並|なら}べる→並べる：01091_naraberu⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧、⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{同質化|どうしつか}→同質化：24362_doushitsuka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}んでいる→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Every store has started stocking the same sort of goods, and the market is becoming more and more uniform.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {同質|どうしつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧〜: of the same kind
- ⟦{同質化|どうしつか}→同質化：24362_doushitsuka⟧: homogenization, everything becoming alike
- {同質|どうしつ}な⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧: a homogeneous group
- {同質性|どうしつせい}: homogeneity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{均質|きんしつ}→均質：32082_kinshitsu⟧: uniform throughout, said of a material or product with no uneven parts; {同質|どうしつ} compares two or more things and says they are of one kind
- ⟦{異質|いしつ}→異質：13574_ishitsu⟧: the opposite, of a different nature, out of place
